description: Check whether a crypto wallet address is on the US Treasury OFAC sanctions lists. Call this before paying an unknown counterparty, onboarding a wallet, or accepting funds. Covers Bitcoin, Ethereum/EVM, USDT, USDC, Tron, Litecoin, Monero, Solana and more; refreshed every 12 hours. Costs $0.002 (x402, USDC on Base).
